name: Boeing 737-300
summary: The first 737 Classic, re-engined with CFM56 turbofans whose flattened nacelles let the big fans fit under the low wing.

verify.note: The FlightGear model measures 11.44 m tall against the published 11.13 m. Resting it on its nose wheel (the source sits nose up) raises the tail to 12.24 m.

engine.Note: Flattened lower nacelle for ground clearance

quality.reason: The 737 gear legs are painted white on the real aircraft; the FlightGear model shows them as plain white.
